scope: S3 protected evidence references, not the app compatibility ledger or launch authorization
rawEvidencePolicy: Keep logs, screenshots, input events, packets, account data and save bytes local. Do not discard failed or inconclusive attempts.

inputAttributionHelper.guards: Unique visible exact-title window owned by the required Windows PID; point within bounds; foreground and cursor checks before sending.
inputAttributionHelper.records: Unbuffered pre-down, post-down and post-up with SendInput counts and monotonic ticks; 100ms hold.
inputAttributionHelper.boundary: SendInput acceptance is not proof the game handled a click. Foreground can change after a check; release is always attempted after an accepted down. No-game validation does not retroactively prove the inconclusive Stardew quit. This helper has not replaced the historical game input binary.
inputAttributionHelper.receiver: One owned window reports its Windows PID, HWND and client-center screen coordinates; requires exactly one received down/up with a 75-500ms interval and self-closes after 25 seconds.
inputAttributionHelper.historicalFailure: s3-input-attribution-selftest-01/receipt.json records an uninitialized CrossOver bottle failure before any receiver or input. It remains preserved.

saveArchiveGapAudit.boundary: Comparison of historical snapshot save-file references against bytes in the existing inventory, not a complete search of the Mac. sessionArtifactArchive.boundary: Verified protected byte copies of historical session artifacts and explicit evidence references, deduplicated by SHA256. Originals preserved. No live save prefixes read or written and no missing historical baseline reconstructed.
